_comment: spec-v7 Step 123 — mutation testing. Scoped to the highest-value pure extractors; a separate, slow, on-demand/scheduled job, never the per-push gate. `mutate` and the `include` list in vitest.mutation.config.ts MUST stay in step — a file listed here whose tests are not included there reports 0% with every mutant NoCoverage. tests/integration/mutation-scope.test.ts asserts they agree.
_thresholds_comment: Regression-only (spec-v7 Step 124): break a couple points under the measured baseline; never an aspiration. Runs only in the scheduled/on-demand mutation workflow, not the per-push gate. Ratchet up as survivors are killed. CURRENT baseline 52.34% over dates+amounts+crossrefs+sections (1,433 mutants), 2026-08-17, break 50. NOTE the number went DOWN from 56.16 when the scope widened from 2 files to 4 — the bar did not drop, the surface grew: crossrefs (42.86%) and sections (51.92%) came in below the older pair. Compare scores only within the same `mutate` set. History: 51.26% baseline (2026-06-05, dates+amounts, break 48); decayed to 47.59 and BROKE the gate as those two files grew without matching tests; covering three then-untested features (trailing currency words, day-month-year dates, the deferred currency override) took the pair to 56.16; scope then widened to four files.
